topics.headline: Oil shock clouds July CPI/HICP outlook; both need to reaccelerate together
topics.summary: US June CPI decelerated to 3.5% and Eurozone HICP eased to 2.8%, but renewed Iran-conflict oil spikes and ECB forecasts of 3.4% peaks suggest both could reaccelerate in July/August data—though prediction markets see July US CPI as a coin-flip, making simultaneous acceleration in both gauges uncertain.

topics.headline: HY spreads near historic lows, but ticking up slightly
topics.summary: The ICE BofA HY OAS edged up from 2.69% to 2.71% as of mid-July 2026, still near two-decade lows; strong bank earnings and resilient IG demand argue for continued tightness, but analysts warn compressed spreads leave little cushion if growth or sentiment weakens.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs post five-day inflow streak, but 2026 remains deeply negative
topics.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in ~$727M over five sessions, the longest inflow streak since May, but year-to-date flows are still about -$5.2B and June alone saw $4.5B in outflows, so analysts and even Citi (which zeroed its inflow forecast) say it's too early to call this a durable trend rather than a bounce off oversold conditions.

topics.headline: VIX calm at 18.65, but FOMC and skew signal risk of a pop
topics.summary: Spot VIX sits low in its recent 16-19 range with the trailing average likely near here, but elevated SKEW, hot single-stock vol, and the July 29 FOMC create real upside risk over 30 days even though mean-reversion and options' historical over-pricing of realized vol favor a pullback rather than a sustained rise.

topics.headline: Deal pace stays torrid: Chevron-Microsoft 2.67GW gas PPA leads June
topics.summary: Despite a March White House ratepayer pledge, hyperscalers keep signing new power deals almost weekly—Chevron's 20-year Project Kilby gas PPA with Microsoft, TotalEnergies-Google solar, and Meta's nuclear buildout—making another announcement within 30 days highly likely given the near-continuous two-year deal cadence.
